messages:
alyssa_csm: Quick check — we're ready to seed the quiet beta with 8 seats across 3 customers. Need to confirm seat owners and when to send the first 1-week usage survey.

maria_success: I provisioned accounts for PulseCo (5), Emberly (2), and NovaArk (1). Invites sent except PulseCo SSO is pending. PulseCo contact is tay@pulseco.com

noah_ops: PulseCo SSO is still queued with okta team, ETA ~2 business days. Workaround: create temporary org invites — i'll create and post links in 15m :wrench:

alyssa_csm: please add me to the temp invites. we'll hold off the survey for PulseCo until they onboard. For Emberly/NovaArk send on MON 9am PT.

josh_product: Heads up — we want telemetry on prompt templates enabled before survey. Can you enable the 'beta_prompt_eval' flag for these orgs? Otherwise metrics will be incomplete.

sam_eng: I'll flip the flag. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.company/flags/beta_prompt_eval \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY\" \\
  -d '{\"orgs\": [\"pulseco\",\"emberly\",\"novaark\"]}'
```
Done in staging, rolling to prod in 10m. :rocket:

maria_success: Confirming — PulseCo invites: https://redwood.app/invite/abc123 (temp), Emberly/NovaArk invites delivered, Emberly accepted.

survey-bot: NEW SURVEY LINK: https://survey.app/rc-beta-week1 — default schedule Mon 9am PT. Results hook -> #beta-qa. 

alyssa_csm: Thanks. Two asks before survey: (1) quick checklist of enablement materials to include (playbook + 3 prompts) (2) tag customers with 'quiet-beta' in console so routing rules apply.

josh_product: Playbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/quiet-beta-playbook — will add 3 starter prompts under 'Examples' page. Tagging is done via console API by noah_ops.

noah_ops: Tagged orgs and set routing policy to use dedicated small-pool. PulseCo remains temp until SSO complete. :white_check_mark:

alyssa_csm: Perfect. I'll schedule the Emberly/NovaArk survey and hold PulseCo. Will post final send with counts. :thumbsup:

maria_success: FYI Emberly already gave initial feedback: \"latency is great, embedding mismatch on 2 prompts\" — I'll capture in the feedback doc. Link: https://notion.redwood.com/quiet-beta/emberly-feedback

alyssa_csm: Excellent — tagging the feedback doc to the survey so we can correlate. Anyone needs a runbook for manual invite flow? 

sam_eng: I can draft a 1-pager and drop it in #beta-ops by EOD.

alyssa_csm: Awesome, thanks team.
